watch.summary: The creator loudly reacts while spectating a player who hilariously fails to notice or eliminate an enemy standing right in front of them.

beats.what: Creator screams in shock with hands on his head while spectating the game.
The hunter jumps completely past the enemy, leaving the creator screaming in disbelief.
The hunter shoots laser beams wildly all around the stationary target.
Creator bursts into laughter asking how the opponent isn't dead.
Creator concludes that the player is just actually terrible.

watch.author: mixed
watch.key_line: How is this guy not dead?
watch.why: The absurdity of a player repeatedly missing an easy target creates instant comedy. The streamer's expressive disbelief and sudden laughter amplify the hilarious gameplay fail.
